headline: CEC Bank for Romanian businesses, a project of ZF and CEC Bank. Daniel Constantin, ARICE: The largest investments being discussed for Romania come from Asia. There are investors who want to use Romania as an entry gateway to the EU
summary: Daniel Constantin, head of Romania's investment agency ARICE, said the largest projects under discussion come from Asia, with some investors using Romania as an EU entry gateway.
why: Foreign direct investment shapes growth, employment and capital inflows in emerging European economies such as Romania.
